verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) documents webhooks that POST message events for every type the story names: send, deferral, hard and soft bounce, delivered, open, click, spam, unsub and reject. Marketing API webhooks separately cover subscription changes and campaign sending, but they require the Standard or Premium plan. Nothing in the pack shows the payloads are signed, which is an explicit part of the story, and engagement events are split across two separate products. Missing for 10: evidence of webhook payload signing or verification, detailed payload schema documentation, a unified engagement-event webhook in the Marketing API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
